purpose: 선택 근거가 숫자나 정보의 양이 아니라 결론을 실제로 바꿀 핵심 사실과 아직 모르는 부분을 표정·손끝 가까이에서 구분하는 close-emotion 12개 편집 검토안이다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-evidence close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair; no extra guardian, adviser, family member, respondent, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one compact evidence control covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Frame face, hand, pincer or fin closely while separating verified fact, felt response and unknown space; never declare a correct choice, prediction, guaranteed safety, status or future outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Evidence tiles, trays, shutters, seals, boxes and sockets remain removable, blank, incomplete or open-ended. Libra may use exactly one abstract evidence balance; no other sign uses a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
